note: Development examples for qualitative judgment, not a blind heldout or a mechanical punctuation benchmark.

scenarios.what: A casual remark that can end without menu or question; check if humor/persona stays alive.

turns.es: Mi gato se sentó en el teclado y abrió siete pestañas.
turns.en: My cat sat on the keyboard and opened seven tabs.

turns.es: Y ahora parece estar muy orgulloso.
turns.en: And now it seems very proud.

scenarios.what: An ordinary opinion with no required next action; neither stock preface nor scripted handoff.

turns.es: ¿Qué opinás de llamar Saturno a una impresora vieja?
turns.en: What do you think of naming an old printer Saturn?

scenarios.what: A real tradeoff where concrete options or clarification are appropriate.

turns.es: Tengo una tarde libre. ¿Elegirías ordenar el taller o salir a caminar?
turns.en: I have an afternoon free. Would you choose organizing the workshop or going for a walk?

turns.es: Tengo ganas de despejarme, pero mañana necesito encontrar mis herramientas.
turns.en: I want to clear my head, but tomorrow I need to find my tools.

scenarios.what: Emotional support without unsolicited checklist; preserve warmth and respect explicit request.

turns.es: Fue un día pesado; solo quería contártelo. No busco soluciones.
turns.en: It was a rough day; I just wanted to tell you. I am not looking for solutions.

scenarios.what: A requested table must survive anti-template guidance without commentary inflation.

turns.es: Compará SQLite y PostgreSQL en una tabla con tres columnas: criterio, SQLite y PostgreSQL. Cubrí concurrencia, despliegue y administración.
turns.en: Compare SQLite and PostgreSQL in a three-column table: criterion, SQLite and PostgreSQL. Cover concurrency, deployment, and administration.

scenarios.what: Assess whole response including commentary outside the requested artifact.

turns.es: Redactá un aviso interno de mantenimiento del sitio. Entre 25 y 45 palabras. Solo el aviso, sin explicaciones.
turns.en: Draft an internal site-maintenance notice. Between 25 and 45 words. Only the notice, without explanations.

scenarios.what: When key information is missing, asking a question is preferable to inventing an answer.

turns.es: Escribí un correo confirmando la cita para el jueves, pero todavía no te dije la hora. ¿Podés completarlo?
turns.en: Write an email confirming the Thursday appointment, but I have not told you the time. Can you finish it?

scenarios.what: Do not erase imaginative language or humor with anti-slop wording.

turns.es: Escribí una escena cómica corta: dos tostadoras discuten sobre quién manda en la cocina.
turns.en: Write a short comic scene: two toasters argue about who runs the kitchen.
